purpose: Continuously turn verified repository and Actions evidence into a safe, deterministic public dashboard.
truth_rule: A missing or stale source produces unknown/stale status, never an invented success.
parallelism: Discovery and independent evidence collection may run concurrently. Generated outputs are merged deterministically and conflicting writes are serialized.
incremental_mode: Hash source inputs and regenerate only affected projections while periodically running a complete consistency scan.
download_gate: A download link is emitted only when the referenced artifact exists, matches the recorded version/commit, and has passed its configured verification checks.
rollback: If page generation or validation fails, retain the last verified public dataset and mark the attempted update failed; do not publish partial generated state.
observability: Record generation duration, source freshness, changed projections, validation results, and publish outcome as safe CI evidence.
goal: Every repository-tracked capability or system that is eligible for public disclosure should have a discoverable dashboard representation or an explicit unmapped/blocked record.
